description: Creates an innovation, invention disclosure or draft Strategy with write consent and creation rights. An innovation stores a title and optional Markdown without creating a disclosure. A disclosure accepts a registration definition, or definition and sourceInnovations together to save the completed disclosure and link its sources. Source files and drawings carry over, and the source decisions are preserved. Source references alone create or recover an unfilled draft. Returns a reference, link and revision; complete state is available through the advertised fetch include_asset capability. A Strategy requires populated Markdown sections. Creation does not publish or request a patent service. Repeated creation may duplicate records; uncertain outcomes require search and fetch reconciliation.

contributors.description: Complete desired list of contributor display names, stored as plain text without email or account lookup. On update it replaces the fetched list; omitted names are removed, so a name stays unless the user asks to remove it. Credit only: grants no access, sends no invitation and is not inventor or assignment data.
